notes:
I found two things on the operators' own pages, but neither page covers your dates. Both sets of hours I found start Sept 8, after August 30 to September 2. I didn't find a zoo, aquarium or playground I could vouch for, so none is listed.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Canadian Children's Museum, inside the Canadian Museum of History",
      "age_fit": "Children's museum; their page gives no age range",
      "when": "Sept 8 to Dec 9, 2026: daily 9am-5pm, Thursdays until 7pm",
      "source_name": "Canadian Museum of History"
    },
    {
      "name": "Canadian Museum of Nature, Ottawa",
      "age_fit": "Child (3-12 years); Tiny Tot (0-2 years) free",
      "when": "Sept 8, 2026 to May 20, 2027: open Wed-Mon 9:30am-4pm, closed Tuesdays, Thursdays until 8pm",
      "price": "Child (3-12) $19, adult $26",
      "source_name": "Canadian Museum of Nature"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Children's Museum:** 
It's inside the Museum of History, and general admission covers both.
 
Everyone needs a timed ticket, whatever their age.
 
Entry is free every Thursday from 5 to 7 pm.
 The page I read didn't show ticket prices. A third-party listing gives the age range as 3-8, but the museum's own page doesn't say.
- **Museum of Nature:** 
The hours above are its winter schedule, Sept 8, 2026 to May 20, 2027.
 
General admission is free on Thursdays from 5 to 8 pm.
 
Their page says prices may change without notice
, and the copy I saw may be a few months old.

Late-August hours weren't posted on either page. Check each museum's site for the dates you're travelling.
